scenes_en: on a rooftop in the rain

templates.name: zh_pop_soft
templates.text:
[Verse 1]
{scene}，我把{emotion}藏在沉默里
你说过的每一句话 还在我心里

[Pre-Chorus]
如果时间能倒回
我想再勇敢一点

[Chorus]
{hook}
就算世界太拥挤
我也会记得你
{hook}
把{theme}写成歌 再唱给自己

[Verse 2]
{scene}，风把回忆吹得很轻
我学会和{theme}和平相处下去

[Outro]
{hook}

templates.name: zh_city_night
en_indie_pop
templates.text:
[Verse 1]
{scene}, I'm trying to breathe
Holding my {emotion} where you can't see

[Pre-Chorus]
If I fall, will you pull me back?
If I run, will you follow my tracks?

[Chorus]
{hook}
We keep moving, we don't look back
{hook}
Turn the {theme} into something we can hold

[Verse 2]
{scene}, the silence is loud
But I'm learning to stand in the crowd

[Outro]
{hook}

templates.name: en_edm_hooky
templates.text:
[Verse]
{scene}, heart on the line
Running in circles, losing track of time

[Build]
Hands up, don't let it go
Feel it rising, let the whole world know

[Drop / Chorus]
{hook}
{hook}

[Bridge]
We turn the {theme} into fire

[Final Drop]
{hook}

templates.name: zh_ballad_gentle
templates.text:
[Verse 1]
{scene}，你走之后我学会慢慢呼吸
把{emotion}写进日记 反复删又重启

[Pre-Chorus]
我以为我可以
假装从未在意

[Chorus]
{hook}
如果{theme}是一场雨
就让它落在心里
{hook}
我把你留在旋律 说给自己听

[Bridge]
也许有天我会懂
那些沉默的意义

[Final Chorus]
{hook}
把{theme}唱成勇气

templates.name: zh_rap_half_sung
templates.text:
[Verse]
{scene}，我把{theme}塞进口袋不让它掉出来
你说的每句像回声 在脑海绕不开

[Pre-Chorus]
别问我有没有答案
我只是还没习惯

[Chorus]
{hook}
把{emotion}写成一段节奏 让它继续摆
{hook}
我们都在路上 只是走得不太快

[Outro]
{hook}

templates.name: zh_rock_anthem
templates.text:
[Verse]
{scene}，把沉默点燃
把{emotion}变成呐喊

[Chorus]
{hook}
别让{theme}把你打败
{hook}
抬起头 现在就要离开

[Bridge]
我不需要完美的答案
我只要你别停下来

[Final Chorus]
{hook}
把{theme}丢向远方

templates.name: en_rnb_smooth
templates.text:
[Verse 1]
{scene}, your name on my tongue
I hide the {emotion} but it weighs a ton

[Pre-Chorus]
Maybe I should let it show
Maybe I should let it go

[Chorus]
{hook}
Turn the {theme} into a slow dance
{hook}
Hold me close until the night ends

[Outro]
{hook}

templates.name: zh_lowercase_tags
templates.text:
[verse]
{scene}，我把{theme}写在风里
让它绕过人群 回到你这里

[chorus]
{hook}
别让{emotion}把夜吞没
{hook}
我们会等到天亮以后

[bridge]
如果回忆太重
就把它交给节奏

[chorus]
{hook}
